title: Tiger Shroff firing case: Delhi Police arrests 4 accused, including 2 women

title: Trump’s tariff waiver on Russian oil: India gets relief for now, but is it credible?
content: For India, the immediate relief is for its crude supply basket and exporters. If India decided to give up Russian crude oil, its single largest supplier would have gone off the table, with no easy replacement amid Middle East tensions. If it continued to buy Russian crude, then the 100% tariffs would have weighed on its exports to the US.

title: Harmanpreet Kaur’s 91 powers India to 3-0 T20I series sweep against Zimbabwe
content: India's women's cricket team displayed sheer dominance against Zimbabwe, clinching the third T20I by a commanding 92 runs. With Shafali Verma and Harmanpreet Kaur leading the charge, scoring 69 and 91 respectively, Zimbabwe struggled in the chase, ending at 124/7 after facing early setbacks. Nandani Sharma's stellar three-wicket performance solidified the win, marking an impressive 11-match T20I winning streak.

title: Chhattisgarh’s Rowghat gets first train since Independence as new rail line opens

It brings its remote areas closer to the national railway network. The 95-km railway line connecting Dalli-Rajhara and Rowghat has been completed at a cost of Rs 1,628 crore. The project reached completion with the finishing of the 17.5-km stretch between Tadoki and Rowghat.

He conveyed his aspirations for nurturing better connections with his father, King Charles III, and brother, Prince William. Harry also reflected on the joyous moments of his children attending a British school, honoring his mother's legacy and embracing a new chapter of healing.

title: Florida county rejects 126-home deal on 51 acres, weighs buying land

Horton, the county sees this move as vital for improving stormwater management and protecting local wildlife habitats. Fernandez achieved her highest singles ranking of No. 4 in the world, showcasing her competitive skills. After retiring in 2000, she transitioned into television and became an analyst for ESPN.

title: Chris Evert’s inspiring journey: How family strength shaped her 18 Grand Slams

Her sister Jeanne’s death led to genetic testing that helped doctors find Chris’s ovarian cancer early. After two recurrences, Evert announced another diagnosis in June 2026. Her story highlights family bonds, resilience and the value of knowing your medical history.

With the echoes of the 2018 ball-tampering scandal lingering, this series' low turnout raises critical questions about the future of Test cricket's allure.

title: Israel Is Funding, Arming Militias To Terrorise People In Gaza: Report

title: 1998 Coimbatore Blasts Convicts Get Parole, BJP Hits Out At Vijay Government

title: UK Bank Operations Disrupted After Power Outage Hits Google Cloud Services

title: Bangladesh furious as Saudi prison list omitted death sentences for 2 citizens
content: two of its citizens, Nazrul Islam and Sweety Akhter, were executed in mecca on October 14 without prior notification to dhaka . the government has questioned why their death sentences were missing from a list of convicted nationals sent by Saudi authorities on September 30 .
